headline: Alpha Blazen Tips
title: Aniimo Blazen Evolution | Beat Alpha Blazen for the Roar Stone | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Blazen is a Lightning Aniimo, and you evolve it from Bolty. First, defeat the Alpha Blazen in Blitzwood. It waits on a high cliff in the south, and you reach it by solving the Gravity Pull puzzle. Bring Ice and Dark attackers, since it is weak to both. The fight rewards a Roar Stone, which you need for the evolution. Have you beaten Alpha Blazen yet? Comment below!
description: Blazen evolves from Bolty after you defeat the Alpha Blazen in Blitzwood; bring Ice and Dark Aniimo and collect a Roar Stone.
